alerts.title: India's Power Shortages Jump to Three-Year High
alerts.summary: India's power shortfall surged to a three-year high in September as El Niño and industrial electricity demand drove consumption higher. Last month, India's power shortages jumped to 560 million kilowatt-hours (kWh). This was the highest level since August 2023, Reuters calculations of daily data from the regulator Grid-India showed on Thursday.
